name: openfigi-mcp
description: OpenFIGI (instrument identifiers) (market data): search_symbols. Every tool maps to a documented end

platform_mcp_openfigi_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_OPENFIGI_API_KEY
platform_mcp_openfigi_api_key.description: Optional OpenFIGI API key (sign up at https://www.openfigi.com/user/signup); raises the search limit from 5 to 20 requests per minute. Sent as X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY.

tools.name: search_symbols
tools.description: Keyword search over FIGIs (POST /v3/search {query, start}); symbol is the FIGI, raw carries ticker, exchCode, marketSector and compositeFIGI. The API always answers pages of 100 and ignores the page size, so the server returns `limit` results and a next_cursor that walks the rest of that page before asking for the next one (the page is held for 60 s, so walking it costs no extra searches). Pass next_cursor back as cursor. Without an API key only 5 searches per minute are allowed.
